space.endpoint: reticle root world position = input hit point; NOT automatically snapped to target center
space.links_local_axis: local negative Z runs from endpoint toward source; local Y is parabola elevation; local X=0
space.projection_boundary: Projection into Godot screen/world is compatibility mapping; use measured board camera or explicit adapter, never treat source units as pixels.

geometry.active_count: floor(distance/1.2)+1, but 1 becomes 0. Iterates only 15 allocated objects.
geometry.phase_advance: offset += deltaTime*0.5; if offset>1.2 offset-=1.2 (one subtraction, not modulo loop)
geometry.phase_reset: No reset in CreateTargetArrow, DestroyTargetArrow, ActivateArrow; retained manager phase across uses.
geometry.zero_links: disable all links; tip localEuler=(300,180,0); return without phase advance or resetting tip local Y.

visibility.default_ring_only: ShowBullseye toggles TargetArrow_TargetMesh renderers. Does not hide TargetArrow_ArrowMesh.
visibility.invalid_click: DoNetworkOptionTarget: IsValidTarget false -> GetErrorForTarget/GetErrorParamForTarget -> PlayErrors.DisplayPlayError -> return false. No Destroy, mana prediction, SetTarget, or SendOption.
visibility.cancel: CancelTargetMode: CancelAttack audio -> DestroyFriendlyTargetArrow(true) -> source Card.NotifyTargetingCanceled; clear origin, sourceEntityID=-1, cursor Show, ActivateArrow(false), ShowDamageIndicator(false), OnEndTargeting callback. InputManager then CancelCurrentOptionMode.
visibility.invalid_no_color_change: No default-arrow valid/invalid color change in inspected source.

origin.use_hand_or_deck_or_zero: hand-zone position; enemy/friendly chosen by arrow type
origin.remote_enemy: same base origin rule without friendly hero +1; endpoint each XYZ = Lerp(current reticle point,remote point,0.1) per frame
origin.static: origin supplied, remote position target, uses same Lerp0.1 branch; bullseyeAlwaysOn=true. No reset of bullseyeAlwaysOn in default CreateTargetArrow found. Static path is used separately, do not silently infer reset.

ordinary_attack_caller.note: enabled only for LettuceAbility or activated tag4089 branch, not ordinary hero/minion attack

damage_text.text_empty: SetDamageText coroutine sets text and calls indicator.Show(false) if null/empty
damage_text.mouse_position: reticle root + z0.75 (not source entity). Scale2.5
damage_text.touch_position: source origin + offset; touch options differ
damage_text.text_source: Entity.GetTargetingArrowText->CardTextBuilder.GetTargetingArrowText; per-card metadata must be verified, do not substitute attack/damage numbers.

limits: No original client execution or gameplay observation used. CIL+serialized source is static evidence.
DefaultArrow closure only; HunterReticle, QuestionMark and GruntyReticle are other actual source branches but not required by current ordinary card pool.
PlayErrors speech/audio/content depends on current rule error and source data; invalid UI timing beyond this call chain not inferred.
